items.title: Blocking malicious npm packages before and during installation
items.snippet: Vercel now checks for blocked npm packages before and during dependency installation in builds , helping prevent malicious install scripts from running. The checks use a blocklist of specific package versions selected for blocking because of malware or security vulnerabilities, with new rules typically reaching new builds within minutes.
